title: docs: add quest solution review rubric
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a focused skill for comparing competing community quest PRs
- Treats correctness as a gate before simplicity and code-quality comparisons
- Keeps branch age neutral and requires complete candidate discovery
- Links the skill from AGENTS.md for discoverability

gist.headline: The quest judge gets glasses
gist.blurb: A small review rubric now helps the hive compare competing Quest solutions without mistaking the oldest branch for the best one.
gist.summary: Added a Quest-solution review skill that requires complete candidate discovery, gates comparisons on correctness, then evaluates simplicity and code quality, with a discoverability link in AGENTS.md.
gist.impact: Contributors and maintainers get a consistent way to select the strongest merged Quest PR based on working solutions rather than branch age.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears tiny judge glasses and reviews several flowering code-plants on equal-sized pots, checking each with a clipboard before awarding a small Pollen badge to the healthiest correct bloom; branch-age labels are deliberately ignored, while a cozy terminal and garden establish the technical review setting.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny judge glasses and holding a clipboard as she compares several code-plants blooming from identical lime green (#ecf874) pots; the healthiest plant receives a small Pollen badge while a retro terminal glows nearby, with soft flowers and vines around the garden shed. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: 'CORRECT FIRST', nostalgic but beautiful.
